subject: Sendoff: Maple Labs kickstart & CS kickoff coordination
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah@maplelabs.com>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@maplelabs.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sendoff: Maple Labs kickstart & CS kickoff coordination

Hi Monica / Ben —

Excited to hand Maple Labs over to you for kickoff. Closing notes and asks below so CS has everything to run a tight sprint-zero kickoff next week.

Deal snapshot (short):
- ACV: $420k, 12 months; start date target: 2026-09-01
- Primary use case: inference for internal search ranking + reranking experiments; average prompt length ~120 tokens
- Contract status: SOW signed; procurement looped (procurement@maplelabs.com) but awaiting final billing details (attached SOW v3)

Success criteria (committed by customer):
- Pilot inference latency under 150ms p50 for 512-token targets during business hours
- Integration of Redwood embeddings for search by end of Q4
- 1 production route with automatic KV prefix caching configured

Technical notes + constraints:
- They requested private VPC deployment but are willing to start on Dedicated capacity for faster ramp. Preference is Private after initial rollout (security team required doc set attached).
- Data classification: "internal PII allowed" — need to confirm redaction policy with Security if we move to private (see security questionnaire in Drive link).
- Expected peak QPS during pilot: 35 rps. Typical weekday baseline: 6–8 rps.

Attachments (included): SOW_MapleLabs_v3.pdf, MVP-Timeline.xlsx
HubSpot: https://hubspot.redwood/deal/4821

Immediate asks for CS:
1) Recommend primary CS owner and secondary on-call for first 90 days.
2) Confirm kickoff cadence: propose 60m kickoff + 30m tech deep-dive next Wed 09/01 or Thu 09/02.
3) Identify any blockers around VPC onboarding or KMS/HSM that would push timeline.

Monica — assigning to you as primary. Ben — please remain on distribution for the first two weeks (customer success SLA & exec updates). I can join the kickoff for the exec intros if helpful.

Quick intro to Maple contacts:
- Sarah Liu, Head of ML Product — sarah@maplelabs.com (primary day-to-day)
- Tom Becker, Engineering Manager — tom.becker@maplelabs.com (infra/ops lead)
- procurement@maplelabs.com (billing contact)

Thanks team — happy to jump on a 15m sync before you reach out to their engineers.

—
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com

(Attachments: SOW_MapleLabs_v3.pdf, MVP-Timeline.xlsx)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Thanks Ava — appreciate the concise handoff.

Ben and I reviewed the SOW and timeline. I'll be the primary CS owner for the kickoff and the first 90 days; Ben will be the executive sponsor for the account during ramp.

Proposed immediate plan:
- Wed 09/01 10:00–11:00 PT: Kickoff (exec context, success criteria, owners, timelines)
- Wed 09/01 11:30–12:00 PT: Tech deep-dive (engineering + ops)
- Within 48h after kickoff: Shared runbook with acceptance gates and contact roster

Two quick clarifying Qs before we lock calendar:
1) Is the customer's desired start-of-billing date definitely 09/01, or are they flexible by a week?
2) For the private VPC ask — do they have an internal security questionnaire we should pre-fill, or should we send our standard VPC checklist?

Sarah / Tom — Monica here, I'm your CS lead. Short intro: I run activation for similar infra-heavy customers and will coordinate the kickoff + milestones. Could you confirm preferred kickoff dates/times and whether your security team wants to handle the VPC questionnaire pre-kickoff?

I'll draft the kickoff agenda and share the runbook template to the Drive link as soon as you confirm.

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Monica — thanks for picking this up. 09/01 works for us for the kickoff slots you proposed. We prefer the 10:00 PT kickoff.

Answers to your questions:
1) Billing start: we prefer 09/01 if possible but can accept up to 09/08 if there are onboarding delays.
2) Security questionnaire: I'll share our internal checklist (we filled a short version during procurement). Tom will drop the questionnaire in this thread in a minute.

Also: two internal asks from our side for the kickoff agenda:
- Please include a short section on batching/latency tradeoffs for our engineers — we want to understand quantization and caching knobs early.
- A single-page acceptance criteria doc that we can share with Finance and Procurement to confirm go/no-go metrics.

Looking forward — Sarah
Head of ML Product, Maple Labs
sarah@maplelabs.com
